facts.business: Shriram Asset Management Company Limited operates as an asset management company managing mutual fund schemes and providing investment management services.
key_risks: Global financial market volatility due to tariff uncertainties and geopolitical tensions
Foreign portfolio outflows exceeding ₹1 lakh crore
Rupee depreciation against US dollar touching record lows past ₹95
Elevated crude oil prices from geopolitical tensions
Rising bond yields weighing on market sentiment
Global capital gravitating towards AI-led opportunities in developed markets
Stretched valuations and tighter liquidity conditions in small-cap segment
facts.related_party_note: Material related party transaction with Shriram Finance Limited (SFL) approved for ₹2,29,200 per annum from October 1, 2026 with 5% annual escalation. Previous FY 2025-26 transactions included: Share of Common Infrastructure ₹0.0258 crore, Other expenses ₹0.002 crore, Property on Rent ₹0.0181 crore, Interest Income ₹2.3384 crore, Investment in FD ₹25 crore, Maturity of FD ₹20 crore, Interest on FD ₹6.5192 crore. Transaction value is 0.78% of Company's annual consolidated turnover of ₹2,95,16,798 for FY 2025-26.
